notesEn.TWN: UN DESA counts foreign citizens in Taiwan, including residents from mainland China (about 250,000 in 2024, mostly spouses). For comparison, the National Immigration Agency counted 1,028,945 foreign residents at the end of 2025 (holders of alien resident certificates, excluding mainland China, Hong Kong and Macau): Indonesia 351,057, Vietnam 316,827, the Philippines 184,343, Thailand 81,906, most of them migrant workers in industry and care.
